composition.title: Fanon — Language, White Gaze, Racialised Body, Mask, and Recognition

scenes.title: Speaking opens access and installs a measure
The body returns from a gaze that precedes it
The mask becomes an inward criterion
Recognition must change the relation that distributes it
The historical person remains available to answer

expression:return-of-zero:roz-mytheme-na.title: the language — access and inherited judgement at once
the speaker — acquiring real capacity; hearing himself through the standard
the measure turned inward — then applied to others
the train carriage — the practical bodily orientation interrupted
the hail — "Look, a Negro!" — the smile becoming the child's fear
historico-racial schema → epidermal racial schema — the field giving the visible body its force
the mask — legible form, opened participation
the inward measure — anticipation, editing, the unapproved response as defect
the double edge — access reinforcing the measure admission depended on
recognition — more than one participant's changed self-description
the unequal history — one participant inheriting an authority to classify
the revised terms — who determines the conditions of recognition
the mask returned to the scene that made it meaningful
the four flags — adaptive interface, category before encounter, co-internality, idol/image: all human-amplified: no
Number Six · Apollo–Daphne · the moving mirror · Attica — comparisons that must return to distinct worlds
A27 — the other's reality not exhausted by a prior image (project synthesis, human-amplified: no)
